headline: TerraMar Capital Acquires Village Gourmet and French Charcuterie Brands
summary: TerraMar Capital has acquired Village Gourmet, the specialty food company behind heritage French charcuterie brands Three Little Pigs and Fabrique Délices, marking a new chapter of growth for the brands.
why: Private equity and investment firms acquire specialty food companies to expand their market presence and drive operational growth in niche consumer goods sectors.
